DILG DACONO PILIPINAS Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA cor, Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City www.dilg.gov.ph OILG OPINION NO. FEB 2 6 2025 MR. MARC A. MAGDAYAO Barangay Tigman, Aborlan Province of Palawan Dear Mr. Magdayao: s. 2029 This refers to your earlier letter seeking guidance to determine who is authorized to occupy the vacant position in the last position in the Sangguniang Barangay of Barangay Tigman, caused by the untimely demise of Punong Barangay Brian Viguella. The vacancy in question is the seventh seat in the Sangguniang Barangay, in which case automatic succession does not apply. Thus, Section 451 of Republic Act No. 7160, otherwise known as the Local Government Code of 1991, finds application. Under Sec. 45 of the same law, the city or municipal mayor, in case of sangguniang barangay, upon recommendation of the sangguniang barangay concerned, shall fill the vacancy. As regards your statement that "Sa kabila ng isinasaad ng batas na ang dapat maupo sa ika-pitong pwesto ay ang immediate familV, we find this without legal basis. The Local Govemment Code gives discretion tot the sangguniang barangay as to who they will recommend to fill the vacancy. Moreover, the Resolution filed by Kgd. Ana May D. Viguella, with the support of 35% of the barangay constituents, is not legally binding on the sangguniang barangay. At most, it only has persuasive effect Lastly, with regard to your complaint that the list of AKAP beneficiaries were replaced on the spot after the death of your Barangay Chairman, we shall refer this to the Department of Social Welfare and Development as it falls within their jurisdiction and expertise. This opinion is based solely on the facts and representations you have narrated in your letter and our appreciation of the same. Further, this opinion is being rendered without prejudice to any contrary opinion of competent authorities and the courts. 1 1 Section 45. Permanent Vacancies in the Sanggunian. - a) Permanent vacancies in the sanggunian where automatic succession provided above do not apply shall be filled by appointment in the following manner. I) The President, through the Executive Secretary, in the case of the sangguniang panlalawigan and the sangguniang panlungsod of highly urbanized cities and independent component cities; 2) The governor, in the case of the sangguniang panlungsod of component cities and the sangguniang bayan; 3) The city or municipal mayor, in the case of sangguniang barangay, upon recommendation of the sangguniang barangay concerned. "Matino, Mahusay at Maaasahan" Trunkline No. (02) 8876-3454

Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY ATTY. ROMEO P. B NITEZ Undersecretary for External, Legal and Legislative Affairs OUSELLNRPBULLLS-LRALLD/jvpr/0D
